lines.note: The bed, night, search, and unanswered call match; the opening gazelle and mountains passage has no counterpart in this Greek chapter.
Matches the search through the city, markets, and streets; Ge'ez adds an unanswered-call refrain.
Matches the adjuration to Jerusalem's daughters and awakening love; Ge'ez expands it with resurrection language.
Ge'ez splits the wilderness and smoke imagery from the myrrh, frankincense, and perfumer's powders, adding cloud and breast imagery.
Silver pillars begin in Ge'ez 11; gold support, purple seat, interior pavement, and Jerusalem's daughters continue in 12, with added gemstones.
Matches Zion's daughters, Solomon's crown, his mother, wedding, and gladness; Ge'ez adds suffering and crucifixion days.
